[Home] ↣ [Privacy Protections Tests] ↣ [Fingerprinting Test Page]
This page collects various datapoints from your browser that can be used for fingerprinting.
⚠️ Please note that:
not all of the properties listed here have to be modified to succesfully prevent fingerprining,
depending on the brower some properties may change randomly on every page reload or test run,
some data is duplicated, but it's retrieved using different methods,
this page has to be loaded over https for all tests to work correctly (some APIs are not available over http).
Start the test
Include all headers and all properties of window, navigator and screen objects
